hypothesis: An explicitly supplied rank-one lexical/layout decomposition learns held word-layout bindings from outcomes, with no role labels; compare unchanged fresh GRU and additive control.

design.training: 640 fresh single-contact NAND outcomes plus original 384 bilingual TRAIN outcomes; all arms freshly initialized, equal mean per event. Contacts/receives and dax/vok bridge all three layouts; other pairs learn one home layout.
design.holdout: Eight withheld cells for tav/pel and zun/vek. Third VOS layout, mixed-layout return4/cross5 schedules, 3/6 entities, both modes, core000/111, role reversals, all three layout rotations and opposite final words. No novel physics or independence claim.
design.feedback: Native acquisition/reset context and complete noiseless endpoint readings; no gold participant order, word meaning or mode label enters fitter.
design.retention: Forecast both opened old bilingual and lexical banks with each new arm; compare archived lexical-v1 retention/grounded traces without replaying the old models. Do not train on either old challenge.
design.controls: All three arms collect canonical plus final-only mask/swap views on fresh bank; same true prefix. Additive ablates multiplicative interaction. No capacity/consumed-compute matching claim.
design.decision: Factor must pass each family/word/layout world/order95%, NLL<=.05, critical p>=.9/foil<=.1, lexical gap>=.8, both lexical/role conjunction95%, control invariance, zero native/old exact regressions and20 percentage-point held-order gain over additive at every law/seed. Retain every probability loss and all failed seeds; GRU tie is not a failure.
design.publication: Freeze source/recipe/all data hashes before any fit; publish actual weight bundle before collection. Runner publication SHAs are externally verified caller attestations, not independent network authentication.
design.failure: One fit/collection attempt; exclusive outputs; no retries, checkpoint selection or post-challenge tuning. Missing records or invalid bindings STOP. Result failure does not erase previous studies.
design.limits: Same-team public custody; supplied low-rank model, roster identity, event boundaries, two native contact candidates, full-feedback and mode filtering. No G3 completion/general language claim.
